protocol.treatment: live Jev-backed SignalWeave card evaluation followed by the same Luna agent handoff; complete ignore outcomes are push-gated and do not wake Luna
protocol.baseline: the same Luna agent, same owner-reviewed card, same public catalog and connector tools, without SignalWeave tools
protocol.review: independent fixture reconstruction, score recomputation, same-card check, raw-route check, provenance and push-gate checks

failed_and_fixed.failure: A required Airflow completeness ref was omitted from Luna numeric claims even though the SignalWeave comparison provenance included it.
failed_and_fixed.fix: The treatment handoff now requires every matching provenance query ref, including quality/completeness sources, on each numeric claim and in the top-level evidence refs.
failed_and_fixed.verification: Lumen rerun changed treatment from 2/3 to 3/3 exact structured cases.

failed_and_fixed.failure: An optional Jev follow-up could turn an initial complete ignore into an investigation when the follow-up failed.
failed_and_fixed.fix: Optional follow-up failure no longer manufactures an alert from a primary no-action decision.
failed_and_fixed.verification: Regression coverage plus fresh push-gated Juniper and Lumen runs.

failed_and_fixed.failure: A comparison could cite an installed resource that was not inspected in the current run.
failed_and_fixed.fix: Required comparison provenance now blocks as insufficient_data until every installed resource ref is resolved and inspected.
failed_and_fixed.verification: Engine regression test and fresh Lumen onboarding rerun.

failed_and_fixed.failure: An older Juniper artifact was reconstructed with a changed fixture digest after the catalog RNG fix.
failed_and_fixed.fix: The independent reviewer rejects digest-mismatched artifacts instead of treating them as evidence.
failed_and_fixed.verification: The old artifact fails the review gate; the fresh Juniper artifact passes.

supported: On two fresh, live-Jev, noisy multi-connector simulations, SignalWeave preserved structured correctness parity with Luna while reducing warm downstream agent work.
Push-gated complete ignores removed one of three downstream Luna wake-ups in each company without unsafe suppression.
The typed SignalWeave route, recipient, numeric and provenance checks passed all six treatment periods.
The result is not Superset-specific: one profile was Superset-led and the other was Trino-led, and both included other connector identities.
not_supported: General accuracy superiority: both arms tied 3/3 in each live profile.
Lower total or subscription cost: Jev usage and onboarding work were additional, and the recorded dollar values are illustrative API-equivalent estimates.
Faster first-run onboarding: treatment cold onboarding took about 65 seconds for Juniper and 101 seconds for Lumen versus about 23 and 27 seconds for the baseline.
Universal connector correctness, narrative quality, real-customer usefulness, or production notification safety.
interpretation.next_bar: Run at least three additional independent companies/profiles with the same-card protocol, measured provider/query cost, blinded narrative review, and a held-out multi-period replay before claiming general superiority.
